copyPrompt:
Use the Full Standalone Isometric Game Buildprint at https://agent-buildprint.com/buildprints/standalone-isometric-game/agent.md.
Read BUILDPRINT.md, then 00-goal.md. For hosted phase routing, use https://agent-buildprint.com/buildprints/standalone-isometric-game/files/package.json and load only the applicable phase entry and active loop.
Scaffold the pinned framework host first. For released v2 routing, run npm install --save-dev agent-buildprint@0.1.0 and npx --no-install agb start ./node_modules/agent-buildprint/buildprints/standalone-isometric-game/package.json . The later current-source production-gate policy requires one fresh source checkout's matching CLI and local packet: record git rev-parse HEAD and keep that checkout unchanged for the run. Neither route updates existing snapshots. Remote v2 start requires a manifest SHA-256 from a separately trusted source.
Preserve one PROJECT_CONTRACT.md and all prior approvals. Loading a packet does not authorize provider spending, uploads, publication or deployment. Authorized implementation includes routine build, test and contract-required acceptance work unless explicitly restricted. Choose asset technique before optional providers. CLI records byte-bound attestations, not verified pixels or gameplay. Finish with an honest evidence/blocker handover.
